title: Funko Pop! Animation Boruto Naruto Next Generations Daemon #1918 Vinyl Figure
conditionDescription: Figure is clean with no paint flaws. Box has been opened (one photo shows the figure out in its insert) and has light shelf wear: minor corner wear and a small scuff on the top panel's POP! logo. See photos.
descriptionText:
Funko Pop! Animation #1918 Daemon from Boruto: Naruto Next Generations. Vinyl figure, about 3.75 in. tall, in the original window box with plastic insert.

Figure is clean with no paint flaws; the box has been opened. Box shows light shelf wear - see photos. Two available; the photos show the actual boxes.

Ships boxed and padded to protect the window box.
